title: Wukong food delivery app, tied by Kaspersky to SparkCat crypto-stealing malware, reportedly returns to App Store
what_changed: Summary said the app returned with version 1.0.7 on 24 November; crypto.news says it returned in October and 1.0.7 was released 24 November. Removed unsupported 'bundle ID' and attributed the October Apple block to Bodu News.
